answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 3594 Country: Pakistan Title: Please clarify the minimum size of Beared? Question: Assalamo Aalaikum! Please clarify the minimum size of Beared "Darhi". Answer ID: 3594 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 527/416=B) It is wajib (required) to grow beard at least one fist. Trimming beard before one fist or shaving it is such a sin which one commits every moment while sleeping, waking etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
